item.description: The Aera x Todd Snyder D 1 Diver is what happens when strong design discipline meets real world utility. item.title: BENETTI B.NEOS YACHT
item.description: The striking new Benetti B.Neos Yacht feels like a confident step forward for modern yachting, not louder or bigger, but calmer and far more intentional. At 40 meters, this new generation displacement yacht focuses on what actually improves life at sea rather than chasing excess. Designed in collaboration with MMYD, the Benetti B.Neos Yacht carries long, low lines inspired by sailing yachts, with proportions that feel balanced, elegant, and refreshingly restrained. item.description: Few jackets carry the legacy of the N 1 deck jacket, and the SPC/LST Maritime_01J Jacket handles that heritage with real intent. item.title: DJI NEO 2 PALM-SIZED DRONE
item.description: The DJI Neo 2 Palm Sized Drone might be the most approachable camera drone DJI has released to date. item.description: The Hilts Sunfaded Sweatshirt from imogene + willie is a thoughtful nod to classic 1950s athletic wear. item.title: RENOSTERBOS CABIN
item.description: Renosterbos Cabin is a private off grid retreat tucked between acacia trees on a nature reserve in Bonnievale, about two and a half hours from Cape Town. Zebra, eland and wildebeest roam the surrounding landscape, creating the kind of setting where luxury and wilderness sit comfortably side by side. Designed for long days outdoors, the cabin features a wood fired hot tub, splash pool, cargo nets and a dreamy outdoor bath, all positioned to take in the views.
